text:
Type: black swing-arm floor reading lamp

Style: industrial, farmhouse, retro
Materials: matte black powder-coated steel, brass-tone details, braided textile cord
Colors: matte black, brass
Shape: tall pole with a long counterbalanced horizontal arm, dome shade on one end, brass pivot joint and socket, round heavy base, linear and graphic, medium visual weight
